messages:
sam: quick heads-up — nightly throughput dipped ~11% on the t4-dedicated pool for the 8k-seq model after we bumped max_tokens_per_batch. can someone run a quick profile? PR #4256 touched the batching heuristics.

sam: basic metrics I saw: baseline ~1150 tok/s -> current ~1023 tok/s, p50 latency +9%. logs show more frequent small-batch flushes and increased enqueue wait.

sam: repro command I used:
```
./loadgen --model rwl-8k --cpus 8 --gpus 1 --concurrency 8 --seq 8192 --max_batch_bytes 65536 --max_batch_size 128 --max_tokens_per_batch 8192 --warmup 1000 --iters 5000
```

sam: ran on commit 0f3a7b (PR 4256). tagging @maria and @jia for profiling + quick tuning ideas.

maria: on it — I'll run a kernel-level profile + continuous-batching trace. will upload perf artifacts to this thread. ETA 20–30m.

maria: quick Q — do you want me to keep max_batch_size at 128 for the probe, or cap at 64?

jia: cap at 64 first. my hunch: oversize batches are increasing the queueing window and hurting KV-cache locality / small prefetched work. try 64 then 32 if needed.

jia: also try lowering batch_window_ms (48ms vs current 200ms) for a quick A/B — 30-min smoke should reveal tail behavior.

liz: fwiw perf-bot's nightly (job 9021) already flagged a regression but that run used the old heuristics (pre-0f3a7b). if we want fast A/B I can spawn two short runs: commit 0f3a7b vs rollback candidate.

liz: proposed matrix (short runs ~500 iters each): max_batch_size = [32, 64, 128] x batch_window_ms = [48, 200]. will run on t4 pool and push artifacts.

perf-bot: CI job 9021 finished — throughput baseline: 1150 tok/s, current: 1023 tok/s, regression flagged. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/9021/artifacts (logs, flamegraphs).

perf-bot: scheduled matrix run 9030 (matrix: sizes [32,64,128], windows [48,200]). expecting ~2h to finish on the dedicated queue.

maria: kicked off a focused profile run with these commands (short):
```
./loadgen --model rwl-8k --gpus 1 --concurrency 8 --seq 8192 --max_batch_size 64 --batch_window_ms 48 --iters 2000 --trace cb_trace_1767.tgz
```

maria: small flame snippet from kernel trace (top lines):
```
kv_cache_miss: 34%
enqueue_wait_ms_p50: 12.4
batch_flushes_per_sec: 18.2 -> 24.7 (current)
```

maria: uploading cb_trace_1767.tgz to artifacts now.

sam: perfect — thanks. please paste results here when done. if any config shows >2% throughput improvement we should canary that tuning and consider reverting the heuristics change in PR 4256. :thumbsup:

liz: noted. I'll also add a quick perf-alert to monitor the canary runs.

sam: linking this thread from PR 4256 so the reviewer can see the data: https://git.redwood/pr/4256

jia: if anyone sees memory/regressor signs in the traces ping me and I'll dig into kernel scheduling.

sam: ok team — running checklist: 1) run matrix (liz) 2) run traces (maria) 3) quick heuristics rollback A/B (liz) 4) analysis + next steps (jia). thanks all.
